text: Bitcoin's modest gain is lagging altcoins, suggesting selective buying interest rather than broad risk-on sentiment. Ethereum's slightly firmer performance (+0.6%) reflects steadier demand, though both majors are barely moving in what appears to be a consolidation phase. The Fear & Greed index at 27 and rising volume of $41B indicate cautious repositioning as investors test whether support holds, with Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 56.5% despite the marginal outperformance elsewhere.
